description: DiligenceOps: submit up to 200 subscriptions or recurring charges (name, amount, currency, cadence, last charge date, prior amounts and charge dates when known). The signed report flags duplicate services, price increases against prior amounts, charge intervals off their cadence and double charges, and charges whose last date is stale, with annual and monthly equivalents per currency. POST /api/subscription-audit. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/diligence-checks-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

as_of.description: Audit date. Defaults to the check time.

stale_grace_days.description: Days past the expected next charge before a charge counts as stale. Default 7.

subscriptions.description: Up to 200 subscriptions or recurring charges.

charge_dates.description: Earlier charge dates, for the cadence check.

items.description: ISO date (2026-11-04) or datetime with a timezone (2026-11-04T17:00:00Z).

currency.description: Currency or token code, for example USD, EUR or USDC.

last_charge_date.description: ISO date (2026-11-04) or datetime with a timezone (2026-11-04T17:00:00Z).

name.description: Service name as it appears on the statement or account.

prior_amounts.description: Earlier amounts, oldest first, or as {amount, date}.

anyOf.description: A non-negative amount as a decimal string or number, up to 6 places, for example "49.99".

amount.description: A non-negative amount as a decimal string or number, up to 6 places, for example "49.99".

date.description: ISO date (2026-11-04) or datetime with a timezone (2026-11-04T17:00:00Z).

name: wever_subscription-audit
title: Subscription audit
